title: About and Status
summary: The plugin's status window -- versions, connection health, and which indexes are actually in use
intro: Read this when hover or go-to-definition seems to answer from the wrong place, or you need to know what is running. The status window shows the versions in use, whether each component is reachable, which index files are actually being used, misconfigured settings and how much memory the IDE holds.

steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Read the version, connection-health, index-file, settings and memory groups
Use Refresh to re-read every group, or Diagnose Current State to get a report to paste into an issue

surfaces.usage: drag-lint info [--json] [--db <file.sqlite>]... (engine self-info: product/extractor/resolver versions, build date, MIT, tree-sitter + capabilities; read-only)

surfaces.caption: Check for Updates
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Check for Updates to look for a newer release

surfaces.caption: Close
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Close to dismiss the window

surfaces.caption: For help and additional information refer to:
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click the website link at the top of the window to open https://www.delphi-rag-lint.com

surfaces.caption: Website (Help)
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Website (Help), or the link at the top of the window, to open https://www.delphi-rag-lint.com for help, articles and downloads

surfaces.caption: Copy Diagnostics (Current File)
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Copy Diagnostics (Current File) to put the current file's findings on the clipboard

surfaces.caption: Copy Report
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Copy Report to put the full status report on the clipboard

surfaces.caption: Diagnose Current State
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Diagnose Current State to build the full text report and show it in a copyable window

surfaces.caption: Import Build Log...
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Import Build Log... and pick an external build log so its errors become browsable findings

surfaces.caption: Lint Buffer (Unsaved)
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Lint Buffer (Unsaved) to lint the editor buffer including unsaved edits

surfaces.caption: Open Plugin Log
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Open Plugin Log to see the plugin's own log

surfaces.caption: Recover Buffer-Compile Files
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Recover Buffer-Compile Files to recover temporary files an interrupted buffer compile left behind

surfaces.caption: Refresh
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Refresh to re-read every group

surfaces.caption: Run AST Checks
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Run AST Checks to run the built-in AST checks on the current file

surfaces.caption: Run Diagnostics (didSave)
steps: Choose drag-lint > About
Click Run Diagnostics (didSave) to run the diagnostics pass the editor fires on save

questions.ask: Which plugin, engine and index versions is my IDE actually using?
